text_block_list.text:
I visited the shrine, bringing along 
Daring Heart, who has been in a bit of a 
slump lately.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for bringing me here. I was just 
thinking about how I wanted to come.
choice_data_list: ...I knew it, you were bothered by it.

text_block_list.text:
Lately, she had been plagued by bad 
luck—minor injuries, poor health, and 
defects with her favorite gear.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! My smartphone was acting up, so I 
missed your message!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Heart-san. Don't you feel like a 
lot of bad things have been happening 
lately?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, come to think of it... None of 
them are a big deal on their own, but it 
might really be too many in a row.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'd like to think it's a 
coincidence, but... could this be—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, perhaps it really is a curse, after 
all.

Even if it was just cold comfort, I 
considered praying at a shrine, or maybe 
even an exorcism... That was just how 
relentless her streak of bad luck had 
been.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, it looks like you're the one who's 
scared, Trainer♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you're thinking about an 
'exorcism,' no thanks. I don't need one.
choice_data_list: Then why go to the shrine?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Well, you see—it's a "declaration."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If something "unwholesome" is influencing 
me, I want to face it myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because I can't think of any reason why 
I'd be cursed. Doesn't that make you even 
more curious?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"So rather than praying to some unrelated 
god, I'd rather resolve it with my own two 
hands—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's a declaration of my will that I won't 
lose, and that I'll overcome this!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it is... Let's go! 
Destination: the Ema votive tablet corner♪

And so, having obtained an ema from the 
shrine office, Daring Heart...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good! You wrote it very well. "Face 
everything fair and square!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it really does feel great to make a 
declaration like that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Even if the time comes to face something 
wicked, I will overcome it with my own 
strengthâ

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: On my daring heart!
choice_data_list:
...Looks like there's no need for God's 
help after all.

...Looks like God won't be needed after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's for the best. It's not like God has 
time to waste, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, I feel like my 
body's been feeling a lot lighter for a 
while now.
choice_data_list:
Could this be the blessing from visiting 
the shrine?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I wonder? Maybe it turned out well because 
I expressed my firm intention to face it 
head-on.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Things like this really come down to your 
state of mind, after all♪"

In the end, without knowing what had 
worked, Daring Heart made a recovery in no 
time at all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now, we've done all we can, and all that's 
left is to see how it turns out—
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: What! That sound just now was...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Unbelievable! It's cracked and fallen 
right off!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe that curse isn't just in my 
head after all.

Daring Heart's slump would continue for a 
while longer.
